readerCopy.body: A private need is brought before the person who controls the money, access, housing, or family decision. One side describes fear, care, and the history attached to the request; the other points to ownership, rules, and the consequences of giving up control. The Moon makes vulnerability impossible to dismiss, while Pluto exposes the leverage determining whose feelings can alter the outcome. The opposition places emotional truth directly across from material power. The request may be heard, but the meeting shows whether care has any influence when the person saying no controls every practical option.
